source.snippet: Salesforce/Pardot admin asking: 'If I update an existing automation rule which is on repeat, will it match and update all existing prospects that are mapped?' — confusion about GDPR compliance automation behavior after rule edits in Account Engagement (Pardot).

problem_statement: Salesforce/Pardot admins managing GDPR compliance workflows cannot reliably predict how edited automation rules behave on existing prospect records, creating compliance risk and requiring expensive consultant time to validate.
target_segment: Marketing operations managers and Salesforce admins at mid-size to enterprise B2B companies using Pardot/Account Engagement for GDPR compliance
notes: Business context: Pardot licenses are $1,250–$15,000+/month. Compliance errors carry regulatory cost. Buyer is a company paying for Salesforce. Signal is a single question but represents a recurring class of confusion for paid platform users.
